about_short_description.short_description: The first automated mobile platform to sell reduced food before it goes to waste. Increasing revenue and decreasing waste.

product.name: Gander Platform
product.description: A software platform that connects grocery retailers' markdown inventory with local shoppers to reduce food waste and recover revenue.

product.name: Gander Reach
product.description: A service that distributes grocery retailers' markdown inventory to millions of local shoppers through multiple digital channels automatically.

product.name: Gander Engage
product.description: An AI-powered messaging service that sends personalized, timely messages to customers to boost sales and reduce food waste.

product.name: Ganderlytics
product.description: A centralized analytics and management console providing real-time insights and control over markdown operations for grocery retailers.

product.name: Bruce in a Box
product.description: A plug-and-play markdown app that enables grocery retailers to launch reduced-to-clear sales instantly without complex setup.

product.name: Gander Consumer App
product.description: A mobile app that allows consumers to find real-time markdowns on food products at local grocery stores to save money and reduce food waste.
